'''Echo Station 5-2''' was a scout post that was situated at the perimeter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], located on the ice-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. It was attacked during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
